title: Analog Watch Face Builder
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: Design an analog face for a 360 by 360 round display by choosing radii and a palette, and use Erase mode to see which items an erased second hand damages.

learningObjectives: Create an analog watch face layout by choosing radii and colors
Analyze which parts an erased hand damages on a direct write display
prerequisites: Round displays and direct write displays (Chapter 15)

keyQuestions: How long can the second hand be without touching the numerals?
Why do repairs matter on a direct write display?
commonMisconceptions: Erasing a hand only affects the hand itself
Anything inside the 360 x 360 square is visible on a round display
assessmentOpportunities: Find the longest second hand that misses the hour marks
Explain why a framebuffer display needs no repairs
